semiconductor_relevance: High — RMSCO provides high-purity metals and alloys essential for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Rajasthan Metal Smelting Co. (RMSCO) specializes in producing high-purity metals and alloys, such as copper, aluminum, and precious metals, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing. The company supports the upstream materials segment by ensuring these materials meet the stringent quality requirements of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Precious metal smelting for semiconductor fabrication
